ruleDefinitions.name: JAMF MDM Potential Suspicious Child Process
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential suspicious child processes of "jamf". Could be a sign of potential abuse of Jamf as a C2 server as seen by Typhon MythicAgent.

sequences.query: (parent_process_path = RGX("\\/jamf$") AND (process_path = RGX("\\/bash$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/sh$")))
